verdict.rationale: The structured-output docs say V4 returns `run.result` as a plain string. They tell developers to prompt for JSON and validate it client-side, so the schema validation is a user-side workaround, not something the product does. The GitHub line about extracting structured data to CSV is only an example task prompt and shows no typed or schema-validated output.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract typed, schema-validated data (Zod/Pydantic-style) from pages the agent visits, not just raw text

citations.quote: V4 returns `run.result` as a string. Ask for JSON only, then validate it client-side
